title: OSSSC Forest Guard Result 2026 Out Soon @osssc.gov.in, Download Forester Merit List PDF
fullContentHtml:
OSSSC Forest Guard Result 2026 for Forest Guard, Forester and Excise Constable posts is expected to be released soon on the official website of Odisha Subordinate Staff Selection Commission @osssc.gov.in. According to the resorts the result is likely to be announced in the third week of May 2026. Candidates who appeared in the written examination from 16 April to 5 May 2026 will be able to download the merit list PDF online and check qualifying status. Along with the result the board will also release the category wise cut off marks. Read below to know more about the Odisha Forest Guard Result 2026, merit list PDF and direct download.

OSSSC Forest Guard Result 2026 Out Soon

Odisha Forest Guard Result 2026 will be announced soon on the official website @osssc.gov.in. Candidates who appeared in the written examination will be able to check the result online. The merit list PDF will contain the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates. The result is expected to be announced in the third week of May 2026. Candidates should keep checking official website for the latest updates.

OSSSC Forest Guard Result 2026 Download PDF

How to Download Odisha Forest Guard Result 2026?

Candidates will be able to check the OSSSC Forest Guard Result 2026 online from the official website. Candidates can follow the steps given below to download the result PDF.

  1. Visit the official website @osssc.gov.in.
  2. On the homepage click on the result notification link for OSSSC Forest Guard Result 2026.
  3. The result PDF will be displayed on the screen.
  4. Check roll number or name in the merit list.
  5. Download the PDF and save it for future reference.

Details Mentioned in OSSSC Forest Guard Result 2026

The OSSSC Forest Guard Result 2026 contains important information regarding the performance in the examination. Candidates should carefully verify all the details mentioned in the result. In case of discrepancy candidates should contact the recruiting body for correction. The details mentioned in the result are as follows.

  1. Name of the candidate
  2. Roll Number
  3. Category (UR/OBC/SCT/ST/EWS/PwBD)
  4. Marks Obtained in the examination
  5. Qualifying Status

What Next After OSSSC Forest Guard Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify the written examination will be called for the next stage of the selection process i.e., PST and PET. The next stage includes the Physical Standard Measurement and Physical Efficiency Test. Candidates who clear the physical test will then appear for Document Verification. Final Selection will be based on performance in all stages and fulfillment of eligibility conditions. Candidates should keep their original documents ready for verification.
